title: Kaijugen anatomical parts study
creator: Softmax / Polyworld contributors, with Codex authoring assistance
process: Native Blender quad cages authored from measured reference contours, cross sections and facial loop guides; inferred depth, live bilateral mirrors, procedural studio shading and actual mesh-edge renders.

reference.description: User-supplied six-panel wireframe diagram: Head, Body, Tail, Arm, Leg, Foot.
reference.license: Reference rights remain with the source; no redistribution or relicensing of the bitmap.

revision: Revised mirrored facial projection, brow depths, eye apertures and cheek contours; nine anatomical cages including separate small body and limb variants; forward-leaning necks, tapered hip insets, integral toe caps and quad redirects from twenty toe columns to twelve ankle columns. Six neutral shadow-catcher studios. Compared with the supplied diagram using an exact unwarped 50% overlay and independent visual review.
